set.body: Bounded S4 prerequisite: an immutable row-paged held-out evaluation cursor over FittedTemplate, preserving training identity, prediction order, every failure row and exact existing eager arithmetic. Explicit whole-feature-operation granularity, PairQuantum bounds visited keys. Independent prediction/cardinality/work conformance, quantum overflow case and mutation proof. Does not close TemplateFit/decomposition family contract.
set.title: Add incremental held-out template evaluation work
